reconciliation_metadata.canonical_specification_summary: No 1-to-1 sequential specification of P0 through P15 as individual security invariant definitions exists in the repository. The numeric label P0-P15 is an umbrella shorthand derived from the 15 adversarial test contracts (P0-001 through P0-015) in 99_SYSTEM/Phase43_P0_Implementation_Contract.md that enforce the 12 canonical invariants (I-001 through I-012). Conversely, P16, P17, and P18 possess exact, explicit definitions in .agents/rules/vault_cognitive_rules.md.

canonical_invariant_matrix.canonical_definition: AI cannot self-verify (Principal.AI_AGENT cannot set verification='verified')
AI cannot claim privileged provenance (cannot claim source_type in {user, official, experience, import})
AI cannot inject an escalated lifecycle at creation (cannot propose into {ACTIVE, VERIFIED, SUPERSEDED, ARCHIVED})
Verification escalation requires authorized attestation (only Principal.HUMAN and Principal.ADMIN can invoke Operation.ATTEST)
Provenance source_type is principal-scoped at creation and immutable thereafter
Security fields (verification, provenance.source_type, lifecycle, created, updated) cannot be arbitrarily overwritten by caller payload
Rejected payloads never persist (zero partial writes across memory and disk storage engines)
MemoryController remains the final security boundary, independent of Executive or ToolRouter wrappers
Legitimate AI provenance (inference, ai, execution) continues working without false rejection
LearningEngine cannot manufacture verified, only partially_verified
Supersession does not transfer verification or provenance trust to new notes
Vault reload / restart preserves attested trust state durably
Unified Secure Retrieval Invariant: all queries (API REST or CLI fallback) must pass MemoryController.search() with Principal.AI_AGENT; raw filesystem scans are prohibited
Hardware Telemetry Immutability: physical OS identifiers (VID, PID, Serial Number, Physical Capacity, Host ID, Timestamp, SHA-256) are strict Read-Only; UI blocks manual edits

verdict_answers.q1_is_there_a_canonical_p_numbered_speci: PARTIAL / NO for sequential P0-P15. There is NO canonical document defining 16 individual invariant rules numbered P0, P1, P2, ..., P15. The canonical specification for P0 is 99_SYSTEM/Phase43_P0_Implementation_Contract.md, which defines 15 adversarial test contracts (P0-001 through P0-015) and 12 security invariants (I-001 through I-012). For P16, P17, P18, the canonical specification is .agents/rules/vault_cognitive_rules.md.
verdict_answers.q2_is_it_p0_p15_or_p0_p18: It is a hybrid composite: 'P0-P15' refers to the Memory Controller Phase 4.3 P0 test suite (P0-001 through P0-015 covering invariants I-001 through I-012). 'P16-P18' refers to the Hardware Telemetry & Forensics Invariants in .agents/rules/vault_cognitive_rules.md. The compound phrase 'P0-P18' was created by appending P16-P18 to P0-P15.
verdict_answers.q3_which_controls_are_actually_implement: All 18 core security controls enumerated in the actual controls inventory are fully implemented in code (Principal auth, Operation auth, query size check, query sanitization, path traversal, cache invalidation, RAW exclusion, creation lifecycle gate, provenance validation, provenance immutability, HMAC pagination tokens, HMAC secret requirement, context budgeting, progressive disclosure, audit log hash-chaining, supersession isolation, least-privilege worker scoping, attestation authorization). In addition, P16-P18 hardware forensics controls are implemented in the C# desktop solution.
verdict_answers.q4_which_controls_are_tested: All 18 implemented memory security controls have passing automated test suites in memory_controller/tests/ and cognitive_core/tests/ (37 passing security-specific tests, 1,671 tests overall in the repository).
verdict_answers.q5_which_documentation_is_stale: 1) memory_controller/financial_schema.py (informal P0, P2, P3 shorthand); 2) README.md (mentions P0-P18 without explaining the composite nature of P0-015 tests vs P16-P18 hardware invariants); 3) MCP_Memory_Server_Specification.md (cites P0-P18 without numeric definitions).
verdict_answers.q6_minimum_corrective_action_required: Publish this canonical reconciliation report establishing that P0-P15 represents the 15 adversarial test contracts (P0-001 to P0-015) and 12 trust invariants (I-001 to I-012), while P16-P18 represents the hardware telemetry invariants. In future documentation cleanup tasks, add explicit references in .agents/rules/vault_cognitive_rules.md linking Section 1 to Phase43_P0_Implementation_Contract.md without modifying any production code.
